rule_hit_review.why: The ingredient is named as on the pack and product page; this is the brand's own transparency style, not jargon for effect.

tone_read: Calm, declarative and educational in Minimalist's voice; no fear, hype or emoji.
language_read: Active and strength match the product page; every line is a page fact or its usage; no superlatives, no natural/chemical-free framing.
